cfd.definition: Contract for Difference — a government scheme that guarantees renewable generators a fixed price per MWh.

strike_price.definition: The guaranteed £/MWh a generator is paid under its CfD.

reference_price.definition: The market price the CfD is measured against.

imrp.definition: Intermittent Market Reference Price — the wholesale benchmark used for wind and solar CfDs.

allocation_round.definition: A government auction round in which CfDs were awarded to generators.

intermittent.definition: Generators (wind, solar) whose output depends on weather and cannot be scheduled on demand.

dispatchable.definition: Generators (biomass, hydro) whose output can be turned on or off at will.
